verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board offers stronger tinted phase grouping but loses finish through much longer perimeter routes, tighter label-to-wire spacing, and a more uneven visual rhythm.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The eight phases occupy the full frame in a balanced three-band arrangement, but broad gaps around the middle and several stretched sections make the composition feel larger than its content requires.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and chips have usable breathing room, but labels such as “short-lived state +,” “validate session,” and “token only here” sit tightly against nodes or wires, while long inter-section corridors consume excessive space.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Distinct tinted, numbered regions clearly separate lifecycle phases and consistently perform real grouping work; this is one of the board’s strongest reference-level qualities.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Blue, purple, green, orange, and red families carry recognizable flow semantics, with red dashed invalidation paths and green success/session paths, though the number of concurrent hues creates some visual competition.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junction glyphs are visible, but the opposed orange and gray arrows between Token broker and Downstream integration overlap ambiguously, and several arrowheads terminate amid crowded bends or section boundaries.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Section headers and node rows generally hold clean registers, but sparse lower sections, the offset application-path block, and widely varying node spacing produce an uneven rhythm compared with the references.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: This is the principal failure: red and orange dashed routes make very long perimeter detours along the right and lower frame, the green route spans most of the upper board, and overlapping runs near provider access weaken directional clarity.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The assigned scores and visual ordering agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first at 7.5, intent-classification-2 second at 7.0, and the board under grade third at 6.0.
